set: A: the whole site: the six pages at rest on one sheet, the screens with the controls, sheets across one visitor's visit through the live site, and the machine's tiers with the passage from one to the next

issues.where: Page 5 of 6, Step 4: Submit at rest
issues.what: The small verification plate in the upper left and the isolated Submit button at bottom center leave the middle of the page looking unfinished. The live sequence gives this space a purpose once the hardware emerges, but at rest this is the least resolved of the six compositions.
issues.fix: Give the resting Submit button a shallow metal socket and carry one subtle seam or track toward the mechanism’s reveal area. Keep the full mechanism hidden so the surprise and the pinball machine’s visual lead remain intact.
